Just stumbled across this sub, and read through every post on it so far. I'll give my two cents now. But yeah the community here is a lot more inactive now, so get a bit more publicity somehow? <3

You're trying to create an entirely new universe here to roleplay in. But before the roleplay starts, you need to create the universe. So first, take the baby steps and begin worldbuilding from the ground up. The first step was the poll. From the results so far, I think its pretty safe to say that Futuristic Sci-Fi will emerge as the victor.

Great, we have the world, what next? At this point, I would suggest you refer to the Create A Pokemon project by online forum Smogon University, whose process can be found here. I'm and active contributor there, and I think that its extremely structured process really helps to create something original from previous source material through focusing on specific aspects of the project at a time.

I recommend that you adapt it for this Universe we a creating.

I'll outline a structure here, which I have adapted from Smogon's, use it, adapt it, or don't use it at all as you mods see fit, I wouldn't mine. Like I said, I'm just trying to give my two cents.

Note: This process is for individual planets in the whole universe. Do it one planet at a time, don't jump the gun.

Step One: The Terrain. How does it look like? A world is made up of its terrain, and so that is what we should look at first. Is it going to be flooded? Or barren and rocky? A mix of both? Let each user stretch their imagination, and make an official Concept Submission each. After a few rounds of voting, the one with the highest votes becomes the general terrain of the planet.

Step Two: The People. Each player can create a race, and the same process as above can be repeated, with the submissions with the highest votes becoming races.

Step Three: The Technologies. How do the people survive on this world?

Then progressively move in, going for the smaller and more intricate things with each round. Throughout the whole process, encourage creative content based on what has been decided by the community so far. Let artists make concept art, let writers write short stories. Animations, wallpapers, whatever.

And after the first planet is done, move on to the next. Repeat the same process with different concepts, create it from the ground up again. Add another step to establish how the two planets will interact with each other. Rinse and repeat. Do this enough, and we will have a universe of our own creation to play in.

TLDR: More structure is needed to create an efficient process for worldbuilding.

Again, just my two cents.

Whats the best way to get rid of crab grass?

depends on how much you have. If the lawn is more than 50% crabgrass and other weeds your best bet is to start over. If you have a few patches the best thing to do is hand pull.... if it is somewhere in between you can use commercial products designed for killing crabgrass. It will probably take more than a few applications over a season. Once the crabgrass is under control you need to make sure the lawn stays nice and thick.. Fertilize regulatory (I do it 3 times a year- fall winter and spring) Moe every week and make sure you don't have irrigation hot spots.

With any weed it is a matter of persistence and prevention.
